settings.heading: How to Book Your Reading
settings.subtext: Simple, easy, and designed for you

settings.text: For question readings, you will receive answers with a full detailed tarot reading for each question.
For Yes/No readings, you will receive only a direct Yes or No answer, not a detailed reading.

settings.question: Do I need to be online during the reading?
settings.answer: No. Since this is a text reading, you don't need to be online. Your reading will be sent to you on WhatsApp once it is ready.

settings.question: Can I ask multiple questions?
settings.answer: Yes. You can choose the number of questions while booking and ask them together.

settings.question: What details do I need to provide?
settings.answer: You will receive a WhatsApp message after booking where you can share your name, questions, and any details related to your situation if needed.

settings.question: Can I book a reading for someone else?
settings.answer: Yes, you can book a reading for another person. Just share the correct details and questions during the process.

settings.question: What if I don't receive my WhatsApp message?
settings.answer: Please make sure you enter the correct WhatsApp number while booking. If you still don't receive a message, you can contact us directly.

settings.question: Are tarot readings guaranteed to happen exactly as predicted?
settings.answer: Tarot readings are meant for guidance and clarity. Your choices and actions always play an important role in the outcome.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.note_text: If you still have questions, feel free to reach out on WhatsApp before booking.
